title: In the Mood for Love
overview: Two neighbors in 1962 Hong Kong form a bond after learning their spouses are having an affair. Cannes Film Festival 2000 — Best Actor (Tony Leung Chiu-wai).

title: Chungking Express
overview: Two melancholy Hong Kong policemen fall in love.

title: Days of Being Wild
overview: First panel of Wong's loose trilogy with 'In the Mood for Love' and '2046'.
